title: Grateful Dead Live at Miami Arena on 1988-10-14
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz) >KORG AudioGate 4 > Adobe Audition CC2015 > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/24
source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (Sony WM-D6C/TDK SA-X90)

ai_review.summary: Excellent UltraMatrix recording of a memorable show, praised for its vivid sound and personal concert experience.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers give the recording five stars, lauding the meticulous transfer, remastering, and mixing that deliver crystal‑clear audio from an UltraMatrix source. The show itself is described as "great" with lively audience interaction, especially during the speculation before the second‑set opener, making it a treasured live experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high (5‑star) reviews highlight both superb musical performance and excellent matrix recording quality, leaving little doubt of a top‑tier release.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers praise the thorough transferring, remastering, and mixing; no complaints about clarity or balance were noted.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Described as a great show with notable audience speculation before the second‑set opener, indicating strong engagement and energy throughout.
